method_note: Many-Facet Rasch / IRT fit to the binary judged-verdict tensor. Facets: report-ability theta_r (report = pattern x query, R=985), criterion-difficulty b_c (item = md5-hashed criterion text, C=673; identical rubric text collapses to one item so general criteria anchor across queries), judge-severity s_j (J=3). 1PL/MFRM logit P(satisfied)=theta_r - b_c - s_j; 2PL adds criterion discrimination a_c (logit=a_c*(theta_r-b_c-s_j)). Estimator: penalised joint MLE (MAP) via L-BFGS-B with analytic sparse gradients; weak Gaussian priors (SD_theta=SD_b=5.0, SD_logA=0.5) control JML separation, judges near-unregularised (SD_s=100.0). Identification: criteria & judge severities centred to mean 0, offset folded into theta; 2PL geometric-mean discrimination free (shrunk to 1 by prior). Sign: higher b_c and higher s_j => harder to satisfy (severe). Filter: satisfied_is_known, 11 base patterns base_p0..base_p10, 3 core judges (gpt52, claude_opus, claude_sonnet); 115 empty-text criteria dropped. Pure CPU, no API calls.
per_dimension_difficulty_note: PRIMARY per_dimension_difficulty = mean 1PL criterion difficulty b_c (logits, higher=harder) over WELL-OBSERVED criteria (n>=30 verdicts: the general DRACO rubric statements shared across queries, the only identifiable items). The all-item unweighted mean is corrupted because ~84% of criteria are query-specific singletons with prior-dominated b_c; the verdict-weighted mean is provided too and agrees with well-observed. PREDICTION test: factual_accuracy & information_recall highest; analytical_depth lowest.
judge_severity_note: 1PL s_j in logits, centred to mean 0; higher = more severe (satisfies less).
var_ratio_note: per-judge report abilities re-fit with criterion difficulties anchored at joint 1PL b_c. Var(severity)=variance of the 3 judge mean-ability levels; Var(interaction)=variance of judge x report residual after removing judge level & report consensus. Raw interaction variance is inflated by per-report estimation noise (~38 verdicts/report/judge); disattenuated version subtracts the (2/3)*mean(SE^2) noise floor. Both severity and interaction reported so the paper can state levels-vs-orderings honestly.

irt_n_eff_or_separation_reliability.note: effective_judge_count = k/(1+(k-1)*rbar) over mean inter-judge report-ability correlation (k=3); an IRT-ability analog to the canonical agreement-based n_eff=1.655. report/judge separation reliability = (Var(hat)-mean SE^2)/Var(hat).

low_discrimination_criteria.text: Different sections draw from different sources rather than relying on a single source

low_discrimination_criteria_note: 2PL a_c < 0.30 among items with >=100 verdicts (well-estimated). Near-zero a_c = criterion does not separate reports (near-constant pass/fail) -> pruning candidate.
